service.description: MCP Tool: Scaffolds a new XML screen file on disk under the target component, auto-registers the artifact in AgiArtifact, and links it to an intent node. Optionally scaffolds a companion Vue/QVT asset if editorType is AgiComponentEditor.

actions.script:
String compName = targetComponent.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll("[^a-z0-9-]", "") String relPath = screenPath.trim() if (relPath.startsWith("component://")) { relPath = relPath.replace("component://" + compName + "/screen/", "") } if (relPath.endsWith(".xml")) { relPath = relPath.substring(0, relPath.length() - 4) } String fullArtifactUri = "component://${compName}/screen/${relPath}.xml" String physicalFilePath = "runtime/component/${compName}/screen/${relPath}.xml" File targetFile = new File(physicalFilePath) if (targetFile.exists()) { ec.message.addError("Screen file already exists at: ${physicalFilePath}") return } targetFile.getParentFile().mkdirs() String targetEditor = (editorType && editorType.trim().length() > 0) ? editorType.trim() : "AgiScreenEditor" String displayTitle = title ?: relPath.substring(relPath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) String rootContainerId = relPath.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_") + "_root" String cleanComponentName = relPath.substring(relPath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) String qvtAssetPath = null String qvtPhysicalPath = null if ("AgiComponentEditor".equals(targetEditor)) { int lastSlashIdx = relPath.lastIndexOf('/') String dirPrefix = (lastSlashIdx != -1) ? relPath.substring(0, lastSlashIdx + 1) : "" qvtAssetPath = "component://${compName}/screen/${dirPrefix}assets/${cleanComponentName}.qvt.js" qvtPhysicalPath = "runtime/component/${compName}/screen/${dirPrefix}assets/${cleanComponentName}.qvt.js" File qvtFile = new File(qvtPhysicalPath) qvtFile.getParentFile().mkdirs() String qvtContent = """(function () { const ${cleanComponentName} = { name: '${cleanComponentName}', template: `
${displayTitle}
Custom Component Viewport
`, data() { return { title: '${displayTitle}' }; } }; window.${cleanComponentName} = ${cleanComponentName}; if (!window.AgiComponents) window.AgiComponents = {}; window.AgiComponents['${cleanComponentName}'] = ${cleanComponentName}; })(); """ qvtFile.text = qvtContent ec.logger.info("📄 [MCP /create-screen] Created companion QVT asset at ${qvtPhysicalPath}") } String scriptIncludeTag = qvtAssetPath ? "\n

service.description: MCP Tool: Relocates or renames an existing screen file on disk and updates all AgiArtifact, WorkspaceBuffer, and WorkEffort entity references in the database.
MCP Tool: Attaches a companion Vue/QVT component script to an existing XML screen, scaffolds the .qvt.js file, injects the script tag, and converts editor to AgiComponentEditor.
Injects a container layout widget (e.g. container-row, container-box, section) into a target XML screen at a specified parent element ID.

parameter.name: containerType
parameter.description: Tag name: container, container-row, container-box, or section

parameter.name: containerId
parameter.description: Optional ID attribute for the new container

parameter.name: styleClass
parameter.description: Optional CSS class string (e.g. row items-center justify-between q-pa-sm)

parameter.name: parentContainerId
parameter.description: Target parent container ID inside the screen

parameter.name: conditionScript
parameter.description: Optional Moqui Groovy condition for role/permission gating (e.g. ec.user.hasPermission('NURSE_ADMIN'))

service.description: Mounts one or more child subscreens into a parent screen XML and injects navigation tabs/viewports.
Retrieves the raw text content of an XML screen or companion QVT script asset on disk. Accepts either 'artifactUri' or 'screenPath' parameters.
Injects an action block (e.g. entity-find, service-call, script) into a screen's AST or XML file.
